rule: When no pending skill has a usable drill, the skill primer falls back to hollow hold + arch hold (3 x 20 s)
summary: A cheap, low-fatigue body-position primer that is the base progression of the kipping skills in skills.yaml (level 0 'hollow/arch holds'). No direct evidence is needed or available for a 2-minute filler; it costs almost nothing. Note: the 3 x 20 s dose is hardcoded in coaching/skills/design.py skill_block, not in config.
